contexts.synthetic_text: I was really looking forward to this place, but getting inside was a nightmare. My mother uses a wheelchair and there is no step-free way in: three steps at the front door and no ramp anywhere. A server told us the side door was locked and only staff had the key. We ended up carrying her chair up the steps while other diners watched, which was humiliating for her. The fries were hot and the portion sizes were decent. Our server was friendly enough when she finally came over. The dining room was loud on a Friday night. Drinks took about fifteen minutes to arrive. The burger was cooked the way I asked, a little salty. Dessert was the best part of the meal, a warm brownie with ice cream. Prices are about what you would expect for the area.

Check your bank statement after eating here. They double charged my card for our dinner, the exact same amount went through twice within a minute. I called the next day and the manager said it was a system glitch and would fix itself. A week later it still hadn't been refunded and I had to dispute it with my bank. The fries were hot and the portion sizes were decent. Our server was friendly enough when she finally came over. The dining room was loud on a Friday night. Drinks took about fifteen minutes to arrive. The burger was cooked the way I asked, a little salty. Dessert was the best part of the meal, a warm brownie with ice cream. Prices are about what you would expect for the area. The menu has a lot of choices, maybe too many.

We parked in the restaurant's own lot, which had no signs about time limits. When we came out after dinner my car had been towed.
